summary: Refactoring plan for the Autopilot agent layer. Identifies three drift problems: (1) CopilotData is a passthrough — should own DataSet, (2) CopilotState is a passthrough — should own StateSet + all scoping logic, (3) CopilotRoute is a dumb model — should own navigation lifecycle. Provides before/after code sketches, estimated line counts, execution order, and forward-looking rules to prevent re-drift.
